title: alchemilla glaberrima var. fallax
intro: Alchemilla glaberrima var. fallax, commonly known as the False Lady's Mantle or Lady's Mantle, is a plant species within the Saxifragaceae family, closely related to the more widely known Alchemilla mollis. This plant is used in herbal medicine due to its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in soothing skin irritations and wounds, and even help protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Alchemilla glaberrima var. fallax include its ability to promote skin regeneration, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds, such as tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
